unresolved_item: All 25 load-bearing joint stacks, bearings, shafts, reductions and fasteners are absent.
The arm actuator concept exceeds its mass target before links, hands, cables and covers.
The leg concept fails its current mass screen and direct-drive hip roll is blocked.
No selected power source, regeneration control, contactors, battery or tether exists.
The 370 mm straight-arm reach and 950 mm span pass hard limits but miss targets.
Shells are solid visual envelopes without wall thickness, splits, fasteners, vents or service access.
Harness corridors, bend radii, strain relief and moving-joint routing are absent.
Collision, self-collision, stopping, fall, restraint and power-loss behavior are unverified.
Mass, center of mass and inertia are not derived because controlled physical parts do not yet exist.
No DFM, tolerance, GD&T, material, FAI, proof, physical test or qualified review exists.
